reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight unifies streaming and continual learning by decoupling model parameters from data representation. Instead of updating weights, the system constructs a context that encodes relevant information dynamically. This allows for rapid adaptation (plasticity) while preserving long-term knowledge (stability). Distribution matching ensures appropriate inclusion of current and prior data, whereas distribution compression avoids redundancy. The framework leverages large tabular models (LTMs) capable of handling massive datasets in-context, enabling real-time inference without retraining. The key mathematical duality lies in treating context as a learned proxy for model parameters, with regime adaptation controlled by scalar weights rather than complex updates. Failure modes include loss of signal due to poor sketching or misalignment of distributions, leading to degraded performance in either static or dynamic regimes.
